WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       CASE WHEN cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS category_fixed,
       cp.category AS category_raw,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gm,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 6 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 3,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) v FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) stores, round(sum(v),2) mine, round(sum(c),2) ctl, sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(v,0)-coalesce(c,0))>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatched
FROM mine FULL JOIN ctl USING (store_id)

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullcost, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN standard_cost=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zerocost
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26'

SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, count(*) n, round(sum(f.net_amount),2) net, round(100.0*(sum(f.net_amount)-sum(f.standard_cost))/sum(f.net_amount),1) gm_pct,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
